title: Episode
description: One player's recorded battle (CONTEXT.md): immutable, hashed over its JCS bytes, stored in the version it was written with (ADR-008 §3). It holds only that player's own channel, team and decisions; each observation is rebuilt from a prefix of `channel` by the ObservationBuilder. Never the omniscient log.

data_class.description: synthetic: CC0, may be committed; private: a real team or a human's games, kept only in private-data/ (ADR-008 §5).

rights.description: cc0-synthetic for synthetic data, owner-private for private data (ADR-008 §5).

channel.description: The player's whole channel, in order, |t:| dropped (a PlayerChannelLog's lines).

runtime.description: A1: in-process sim; A2: local pinned server (ADR-005). On A2 every decision carries its deadline record and decision_context, the never-auto-choose evidence; a reader must enforce it (readEpisode does), since the contract profile has no if/then.

behaviour_policy_id.description: The policy that chose this player's actions.

collection.description: How the battle was collected (ADR-009 §4). Optional: an Episode without it is a plain fixture or a pre-collection record; the training loader (slice c) will refuse it. A reader older than this property rejects an Episode that carries it, so every consumer ships with the change. The reader checks what the profile cannot (readEpisode): a seed only on A1, none on A2.

winner.description: p1, p2, or null for a tie.

DecisionRecord.description: One decision the player made, for one of its own requests.

choice.description: The submitted choice, in canonical engine syntax.

refused.description: The engine's [Unavailable choice] refusal, when the choice was a pending candidate it refused (ADR-006).

source_policy_id.description: The policy that produced the choice.

Deadline.description: Deadline record of one decision on a timed runtime (#678 §4.4); absent on A1, which has no timer.

deadline_outcome.description: How the submitted choice came about (#678 §3).

bank_seconds_after.description: B from the next timer snapshot; null if the battle ended or none was sent.

server_auto_choose_detected.description: Evidence for the never-auto-choose gate (ADR-005), which asserts it is false.

VersionManifest.description: Replay identity of a battle (ADR-003, ADR-007): the pinned engine commit, the format, and the hashes of the engine ruleset and of Areneon's own format rules.

ruleset_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical engine ruleset.

format_rules_hash.description: SHA-256 of Areneon's format rules record (ADR-007).

RequestIdentity.description: Which request a decision answers (ADR-008 §4). A consumer drops a recommendation unless request_seq and request_hash both match, and rqid too when both carry one.

request_seq.description: Areneon's 1-based count of the requests one player has received in this battle, including wait requests.

request_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical request JSON without rqid (ADR-008 §4): lowercase hex.

rqid.description: The Showdown server's request id; present only on the server path (A2), never hashed.

PrivateTeamSpec.description: A player's or the bot's own full team. Never part of another player's observation; a private one is never committed.

data_class.description: synthetic: CC0, may be committed; private: a real team or a human's games, kept only in private-data/ (ADR-008 §5).

PokemonSet.description: One set, as the pinned engine's PokemonSet (sim/teams.ts) holds it. Legality is the engine validator's, not this schema's.

evs.description: Stat Points in the champions mod (ADR-003).

DecisionContext.description: Timer state and deadline budget for one decision (#678 §4.2). Relative durations only, never wall-clock time. Excluded by name from A1/A2 observation equality (ADR-008 §4).

timer_source.description: server: the server's own timer snapshot; shadow: Areneon's model of it (#678 §2.1).

turn_seconds_left.description: T: seconds left this turn at receipt.

bank_seconds_left.description: B: bank seconds left at receipt, grace excluded.

grace_seconds_left.description: G: grace seconds left at receipt; non-zero only at Team Preview.

remaining_decisions_estimate.description: R̂: estimated decisions left; battle only, omitted at Team Preview.

submit_within_ms.description: The choice must be sent within this, from receipt.

policy_budget_ms.description: The policy must answer within this; 0 means skip the policy and send the fallback.

TimerRules.description: The format's VGC Timer settings in whole seconds; they must equal the version manifest's.

grace.description: Grace time, spent only at Team Preview.

add_per_turn.description: Seconds added to the bank per turn.

max_first_turn.description: Cap on the first turn's time.

run_id.description: The league run that played the battle.

seed.description: The engine's seed form, sodium,<hex>. null on A2, where a challenge cannot be seeded (ADR-005); reproduction there uses the server-side input log.

opponent_policy_id.description: The policy that chose the opponent's actions.

opponent_team_data_class.description: The class of the opponent's team (ADR-009 §3), as the writer proved it from that team. Not the source of truth.

EvaluationCollection.description: A battle of an evaluation run (evaluation protocol C4, O3): never training data.

run_id.description: The evaluation run that played the battle.

sealed.description: true when the run's teams and Episodes are sealed (protocol I1, I8).

seed.description: The engine's seed form, sodium,<hex>. null on A2, where a challenge cannot be seeded (ADR-005); reproduction there uses the server-side input log.

opponent_team_data_class.description: The class of the opponent's team (ADR-009 §3), as the writer proved it from that team. Not the source of truth.

SparringCollection.description: A local A2 battle against a human.
